name: Media library
cantPlay: This file can’t be played in the browser
s.name: By name
emptyLibText: All backing tracks, parts, lessons and recordings land here — audio and video, including those added to songs. You can pick several files at once.
discAria: Record: tap to play or pause, spin to seek
armAria: Tonearm: drag to pick a position
songEmpty: This song has no audio or video yet
emptyText: A backing track, part, lesson or recording — audio or video. The file you pick will be ready next time you come back.
dragHint: Drag along the waveform to seek
delText: The file will disappear from the library and from all songs on this device.
newGoesBoth: New files go both to the song and to the shared library.
noDb: Storage is unavailable, files will be lost after reload.
libInfo: Library: {files}, {mb} MB, on this device only.
allInSong: All files are already in the song
vinylHint: Vinyl: tap the record to play or pause. Spin speed follows playback speed.
notSaved: The file won’t be kept after reload
stepHint: Mark an A–B section and speed will rise 5% with each loop
about: Audio and video, speed, loop, timecodes
markAdd: Add a mark at the current position
markLoop: Loop up to the next mark
marksInfo: Marks are stored with the file and show up in every song. Tap a mark on the timeline or in the row below it to jump there.
toSongsInfo: A tick means the song has all selected files. Tapping adds them all to the song or removes them all.
monoFixed: This style keeps the view fixed: {v}.
help.what: Recordings and video to study and play along with.
help.1: “+” uploads files; they are stored only on this device.
help.3: A–B repeat loops a passage and can speed up 5% with each repeat.
help.4: Time marks jump to places in a track; files can be linked to songs.
help.tip: Practise a hard passage at 70–80% speed, then raise it.
